title: Evaluation of Various Objective Functions for Optimal Reactive Power Flow Including Transformer Tap Changer Optimisation
summary: Modern distribution grids with high penetration of renewable generation provide substantial flexibility through distributed reactive power sources and transformer tap changers. This high degree of freedom can be exploited for optimisation. However, choosing an objective function for optimisation is not trivial, e.~g. minimising grid losses may lead to overvoltages and minimising voltage deviations may lead to higher reactive power flows to neighbouring system operators.
